text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I love this tension in the air. It<n>makes it really
feel like things are<n>heating up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My heart is racing as if I've already<n>won... My
body must be predicting a<n>victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can see it clearly when I close my<n>eyes—a dazzling
vision of me running<n>down the road of glory, and us
sharing our joy together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Our happy ending isn't far away!
